name: starhold
description: Inspired OGame-like browser space-strategy learning project

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @starhold/game && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @starhold/server" "npm run dev -w @starhold/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @starhold/game && npm run build -w @starhold/server && npm run build -w @starhold/web && npm run check:sourcemaps
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build -w @starhold/game && npm run build -w @starhold/server && npm run build -w @starhold/web && node scripts/bundle-api.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @starhold/game && npm run typecheck -w @starhold/server && npm run typecheck -w @starhold/web
scripts.test: node --test scripts/check-no-public-sourcemaps.test.mjs scripts/upload-sentry-sourcemaps.test.mjs scripts/lint-check.test.mjs && npm run lint && npm run test -w @starhold/game && npm run test -w @starhold/server && npm run test -w @starhold/web
scripts.deploy:prod: set -a; [ ! -f .env.sentry ] || . ./.env.sentry; set +a; npm run build && node scripts/upload-sentry-sourcemaps.mjs && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply starhold --remote && npx wrangler deploy
